title: Persuasion at Play: Understanding Misinformation Dynamics in Demographic-Aware Human-LLM Interactions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating susceptibility to misinformation and analyzing generated 'top 10 beliefs' for stereotypical associations when prompting LLMs with male and female personas.
Comparing misinformation correctness, persuasion effects, and explicitly prompted persona beliefs to uncover generational stereotypes between 'young' (under 30) and 'old' (over 60) LLM personas.
Analyzing persuasion dynamics, linguistic features, and stereotypical socio-cultural beliefs generated by LLMs when prompted with 'rural' versus 'urban' demographic personas.
